set.body: Add a separate unit-local recorded graded assessor over existing admitted detail/reference hypotheses, filling only absent or pending assessment slots. Preserve reference identity, previous completed/unavailable/refused assessments, detail/address/inventory and rich graph. Reuse the current conditional-grade and quote admission logic rather than deriving grades from fixed-question claim receipts. Prompt shows claim content and exact recall/source evidence, hides previous grades, and records its input condition. Support all retained grades with per-hypothesis outcomes, request-bound import/replay, public API/CLI and a connected workflow. Keep existing direct mapping behavior/schema unchanged. Whole-record cross-target graded citations remain a separately versioned future contract; current hypothesis-owned evidence guarantees must not silently weaken. Verify conditional alternatives, missing/invalid replies, UTF-16 ownership, no overwrite, legacy/rich preservation, projection, installed replay and compatibility.
set.title: P3 recorded graded fidelity over existing reference hypotheses
